sources.title: I'd Like to Know

sources.notes: Break each source video into discrete Q&A entries. Remove filler and spoken clutter, but preserve the actual argument and attribution. Prefer YouTube transcript downloads as the primary source and treat NotebookLM HTML exports as fallback material only. The current ilk-001 through ilk-230 numbering reflects legacy NotebookLM export ordering and should be remapped to the canonical video sequence.
